identity.title: Constraining the Volume Density of Dusty Star-forming Galaxies through the First 3 mm Number Counts from ALMA

paper_type_evidence.quote: We carry out a blind search of 3 mm continuum sources using the ALMA Science Archive to derive the first galaxy number counts at this wavelength.

targets.name: COSMOS, CDF-S and UDS legacy fields (archival Band 3 pointings)

question.value: What are the 3 mm galaxy number counts from archival ALMA Band 3 data, and what do they imply for the volume density of DSFGs and their contribution to the CSFRD at z>4?

evidence.quote: These number counts are then used to place constraints on the volume density of DSFGs with an empirical backward evolution model.
